translation.name: Le'ec Ada' U T'an A Dios A Tumulbene

book.name: SANTIAGO
book.title: Le'ec Ada' a Carta u Tz'iibtaj aj Santiagojo.

content: Tz'iiba'an ti'ijoo' aj Israel a boonoo' a weeca'anoo'o.

Inen aj Santiagojo. Inen jun tuul u yaj meyaj a Dioso, y a Noochtzil a Jesucristojo. Etel a carta ada' a tan in tz'iibtiqui, tan in chiiticoo' aj Israel a weca'anoo' tun tulacal tubajac yoc'olcaba. Doce tuuloo' tu bajil u uchben mamaa'oo' aj Israele.
Baala' a na'at a walac u talel etel a Dioso.
Pues te'i. Hermanoje'ex, qui'aque'ex a wool ti tane'ex a c'ümic a yaja.
A weele'ex le'ec ti tan u yaaltabül wa tu jajil tane'ex a tz'ocsic a Dioso, tan u joc'ol te'ex ti mas tane'ex a tz'eec a wool tu pach a Noochtzili.

Cha'e'ex u betabül te'ex ti baalo' ti'i ca' a mas tz'a'e'ex a wool tu pach a Noochtzili. Ca' a bete'ex abe'e, y p'aatül u ca'a te'ex ti tane'ex a tz'ocsic tulacal u t'an a Dioso. Jumpul que'ene'ex a wool tu pach a Noochtzili.

Wa yan mac ta yaame'ex a ma' u yeel c'u' a ca' u bete'e, yan u c'aatic ti'i a Dioso. Le'ec a Dioso, jede'ec u tz'eec ti'i ca' u yeelte biqui ca' u bete'e. Ma' tu motzinbil u men a Dioso. Bel ilic u ca'a tz'abül u na'at ti chucul.

C'u' betiqui, yan u tz'eec tu yool ti jaj ti bel u cu c'ümü' c'u' a tan u c'aatic ti'i a Dioso. Wa cuchi ca' p'eel u yool u tuculu, ma' qui'. Le'ec mac a ca' p'eel u yool u tuculu, ala'aji, jabix a ja' a tz'iic a chen tan u beel y usc'al u men a iq'ui.
Le'ec a ca' p'eel u yool u tuculu, ma' tu c'ümic a c'u' a tan u c'aatic ti'i a Noochtzili.
Ma'ax c'u' a walac u joc'ol ti'i ti qui'i.
Pues te'i. Le'ec a hermano a otzili, qui'ac u yool u men c'üma'an u men a Dioso.
Le'ec a hermano a ayic'ala, qui'ac u yool u men quetaji etel a otzili. Walac u jobol a ayic'ala, jabix ilic ti walac u jobol u top' a pocche'e.

Le'ec ti tan u nac'ül a q'uini, tan u chücüjtal a yoc'olcaba. Walac u ticsic a pocche'e, y walac u c'axül u top'. Jobi u quich'panil a pocche'e. Baalo' ilic u jobeeb a ayic'ala. Tan ti tan u men negocio. Chen a wilique'exe, ma' yan a ayic'al abe'e.
Biqui ti walac u yemel u yool a mac u bete' a c'asa.

Pues te'i. Le'ec a mac a ma' emi u yool u bete' a c'asa, qui' u yool. Le'ec ca' joboc u q'uinil u yaaltabül u yemes u yool u bete' a c'as y ma' emi u yoolo, bel u ca'a u c'ümü' jabix u naal, le'ec a cuxtala. Le'ec a Dioso, u yadaj u tz'eec a cuxtal abe' ti'ijoo' boon tuul a yaj u yuboo' a Dioso.

Uchac tan u yaaltabül ca' emsabüc u yool ca' u bete' a c'as a maca. Ma' qui' ca' u yadü' ti Dios tan u yaaltic u yemes u yool u bete' a c'as abe'e. Ma'ax mac u paatal u yaaltic u yemes u yool a Dios ca' u bete' a c'asa. Ma'ax Dios, ma' yan q'uin u yaaltic u yemes u yool ulaac' a mac ca' xi'ic u bete' a c'asa.
Tulacal a mac ca'ax hermano a emi u yool ca' u bete' a c'asa, emi u yool chen u men u c'ati. Qui' tu wich u betic a c'as abe'e, mentücü, emi u yool.
Chen u men u c'ati, bel u ca'a ti c'axül ichil u sip'il. Le'ec ti sucaji u cüxte u sip'ili, bel u ca'a ti p'aatül ti pula'an ala'aji.
Pues te'i. Hermanoje'ex, ma' a beele'ex a tz'oques wa Dios u tz'aj te'ex ca' a bete'ex a c'asa.

Tulacal a boon a qui' a tz'abi to'ono, ti ca'an tala'an. Tattzil u tz'aj to'on a qui' abe'e. Le'ec ilic u betaj tulacal aj tz'aj sasil a que'en ti ca'ana. Walac u jeeltal u wich tac ca' a wila'. C'u' betiqui, ma' baalo' a Diosi. Ma' yan q'uin u jelic u tucul a Dioso, ma'ax tz'etz'eec.

Chen u men qui'o'on tu wich, u yancuntajo'on u ca' sut. U betaj abe' etel u jajil a t'ana. Ino'ono, aj ch'a'bejo'on ti ca' u yancuntajo'on tucaye'il jabix a col a walac u püc'bül payanbej a walac u jochbol taanil ca' tun u c'ümoo' ulaac'a.
Le'ec mac a qui' ti que'en etel a Dios tu jajili.

Pues te'i. Hermanoje'ex, ma' u beel ti tubul te'ex a bel in quin tz'iibte te'exe. Tulacale'exe, seebac a woole'ex a wu'ye'ex a t'ana. C'u' betiqui, chunchunbeel to ca' caaque'ex ti tzicbal. Ma'ax a tz'iictale'ex ti jomol xan.
Le'ec ti tz'iic a maca, ma' yan biqui ca' u bete' a toj jabix u c'ati a Dioso.
Yan a p'ütique'ex a betic tulacal a boon a c'asil a walaque'ex a betiqui. Tojaque'ex a na'at a tz'ocse'ex u t'an a Dios a aalbi te'exe. Sa'albüle'ex a ca'a wa ca' a tz'ocse'ex abe'e.
Ti baalo' yan a tz'ocsique'ex u t'an a Dioso. Ma' qui' ca' a chen u'ye'ex a t'an abe'e. Wa ca' a bete'ex ti baalo'o, chen tane'ex a cho'ic a bajile'ex.
Le'ec mac a chen walac u yubic a t'an pero ma' ta'ach u tz'ocsiqui, ala'aji, jabix a mac u yilaj u bajil ichil a neene.
Jadi' u yilaj u bajil ca' tun bini. Tu jomolil tubbi ti'i biqui'il u bajil u yilaj ichil a neene.

Le'ec u t'an a Dioso, toj. Walac u joc'sic a mac tu c'ü' a c'asa. Le'ec mac ca' u c'ümü'ü, y ma' u p'ütic u tz'ocsic u t'ana, bel u ca'a qui'cunbul u yool u men a Dioso, le'ec ti tan u tz'ocsaja. Ma' chen tan u yubic u t'an a Dioso. Tan ilic u tz'ocsic. Ma' tan u tubul ti'i.
—In weel ti qui' ti que'enen etel a Dioso,— cu t'an a maca. C'u' betiqui, ma' ta'ach u tuclic biqui ti walac u joc'ol u t'an. Ala'aji, chen tan u cho'ic u bajil. Ma' qui' ti que'en etel a Dioso.

Le'ec a tu jajil jumbeloo' etel a Dios a Tattzili, tojoo' u na'at. Ma' ta'achoo' u betic a c'asa. Walacoo' u yaantic aj otzil ma'na' etel ix otzil ma'icham. Ma' ta'achoo' u betic a walacoo' u betic a ca'ax macac yoc'olcaba.
